units.source_text: 男孩握住母亲的双手，把自己的脚放在母亲双腿之间，昂首挺胸，将体重托在母亲的手上，左右荡悠着身子。

en.t: The boy held his mother's hands, placed his feet between her legs, raised his head and pushed out his chest, resting his weight on her hands as he swayed his body from side to side.

units.source_text: 不一会儿，他停止了摇晃，又把那个大脑袋向后仰，与身体形成直角，

en.t: Before long, he stopped swaying and tilted that big head of his backward again until it formed a right angle with his body,

units.source_text: 眺望着傍晚通红的天空，眺望方才走过来的桥上游的河边芦苇，

en.t: gazing at the crimson evening sky, and at the reeds along the riverbank upstream from the bridge they had just crossed,

units.source_text: 眺望小桥、桥畔随着微风摇曳的垂柳，以及在傍晚的天空下格外显眼的高高的钟楼。

en.t: gazing at the little bridge, the weeping willows beside it swaying in the light breeze, and the tall bell tower that stood out sharply beneath the evening sky.

units.source_text: 由于把头弯得太厉害，血液不流通，视野蓦地仿佛变得朦胧了。

en.t: Because he had bent his head back so far, his blood did not circulate properly, and his vision suddenly seemed to grow dim and blurred.

units.source_text: 他把自己全身的重量委于母亲的双手上，茫然地失去了自己。

en.t: He entrusted the full weight of his body to his mother's hands and, in a daze, lost all sense of himself.
